test_title: PYST 35: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people A, B, C, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order) . Only three people sit between A and S when counted from the right of S. Only two people sit between A and B. R sits to the immediate right of C. How many people sit between T and A when counted from the left of A?
solution:
Given: Six people A, B, C, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order) .

1) Only three people sit between A and S when counted from the right of S.

2) Only two people sit between A and B.</p&g
